listing.name: Cannonball / OutRun
listing.summary: Use your permitted noncommercial Cannonball Windows player with your own matching OutRun ROM data.

steps.title: Keep your permitted working copy
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted Cannonball installation with the matching OutRun Revision B ROMs required by that copy. Keep its configuration and ROM folders together.

steps.title: Select the completed installation
steps.instruction: Select the native Cannonball player and its working folder. Keep your existing copy available; updates and data stay with you and upstream.

steps.title: Use a permitted noncommercial copy
steps.instruction: This route is for an already permitted noncommercial working copy. Keep the engine and third-party notices and comply with applicable modified-source conditions. You need a lawful matching OutRun original-data set; engine terms do not license the ROMs or every bundled component. Portcove does not acquire a new package for this route. The reviewed original v0.34 setup uses the documented loose Revision B ROM files in its configured ROM folder; DX ZIP support does not apply to this separate player.

steps.title: Confirm the player, then choose Play
steps.instruction: Select the actual cannonball.exe and its complete player folder as the working directory. Normally leave arguments empty; enter separate documented literal options only deliberately. Review and consent to the selected executable, folder and arguments. Registration does not start the player; choose Play separately. Keep each fork and its actual configuration and ROM data with its own working copy.

steps.title: Preserve the copy and every data location
steps.instruction: You and upstream own runtime replacement and data. Before Play with a changed copy or an upstream update, close all actual players and preserve the working folder, config.xml, ROMs, res, scores, custom music and every custom configuration or save path. Keep the previous working copy until ready. Removing the registration preserves all external files. Managed Install, Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and external deletion are unavailable.

warnings: The source grants conditional noncommercial use and redistribution; this registration does not certify arbitrary copies, component permissions or your original ROM data. The existing fresh-package download restriction remains in force.

listing.download_block_reason: New package acquisition remains on hold pending accepted publisher-integrity, original ROM-set and applicable redistribution evidence. An existing permitted working copy can still be registered.
